capabilities: Encrypt selected text inline or an entire note via the command palette
Decrypt encrypted blocks through a clickable secret element and restore plain text to the note
Sign encrypted text with a chosen private key
Delegate encryption to the native gpg executable or run it in-app with OpenPGP.js
Detect the gpg executable path and list available GPG keys in settings
extras: README includes a funding/donation link. The OpenPGP.js Keychain passphrase feature requires Obsidian 1.11.4 or later; in that mode the private key is stored in the plugin's local data.json protected by its passphrase.
problem: Obsidian stores notes as plain local Markdown files with no built-in way to encrypt sensitive text or entire notes.
summary: GPG encryption plugin that encrypts selected text or whole notes using the native gpg executable or the OpenPGP.js library.
